screen_type: conservative research-sample selection, not formal physical capability or algorithm qualification
limitations: Unvoxelized actual measured points inside source annotation boxes may include road/occluders. Counts do not equal pure vehicle surface samples.
First/mid/last panels draw every point in that frame; aggregation is a separate row. Same point size and equal metric aspect are used.
Aggregated actor-local points assume same-frame rigid boxes; no within-scan actor-motion compensation; not full surface GT.
No point-count threshold is calibrated or used as a formal rejection gate.

viewer_screenshot_source.note: The label is fixed. Same canvas can show sampled Gaussian centers and an optional cyan true-LiDAR overlay. Screenshot alone cannot establish which layers were enabled. Actual NPZ counts below are independent of viewer caps/voxel display.
